title: A curve modification cannot contract an isolated whole fibre component
statement: Let $T$ be integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] and Noetherian (admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]), with generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point]. Let $X\to T$ and $Y\to T$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented (locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]) morphisms with pure one-dimensional geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] (every irreducible component has topological Krull dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]). Assume that the generic fibre $X_\eta$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and that every geometric fibre of $Y/T$ is nodal: its nonsmooth points have completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ over its algebraically closed residue field (completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], power series [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]). Let $f:Y\to X$ be a proper $T$-morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], an isomorphism on the generic fibre and between schematically dense open subschemes; schematically dense means that $\mathcal O\to j_*\mathcal O$ is injective for the open inclusion $j$. For any geometric point $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$, no nonempty connected component $W$ of $Y_\Omega$ which is proper over $\Omega$ is mapped by $f_\Omega$ to a single point of $X_\Omega$. In particular a proper irreducible component disjoint from every other irreducible component of $Y_\Omega$ cannot be contracted. No marking or stability assumption is imposed, and neither $X$ nor $Y$ is assumed separated or proper over $T$.
